newsitem.title: USA: U.S. propane stocks up 7.1 mln, near-record build.
newsitem.headline: U.S. propane stocks up 7.1 mln, near-record build.

text.p: U.S. stocks of propane rose by 7.1 million barrels in July, one of the highest builds for this month in recent years, the Energy Information Administration said in its latest report.
The EIA report late Wednesday showed stocks as of July 31, 1997 at 54.6 million barrels, about 8.2 million barrels above year-ago levels.
East Coast inventories rose by .9 million barrels, Midwest inventories rose by nearly 3.8 million barrels, and Gulf Coast barrels increased by 2.2 million.

With only two months remaining in the stock building season, expectations are strong that U.S. inventories will reach or exceed 60 million barrels by the beginning of the 1997-1998 heating season. Many industry observers believe that level is adequate to meet normal winter demand.
